node.title: Re: Net::SMTP and resolving an alias
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [mdamazon],

Although I don't have direct experience in implementing this, assuming you've got a Windows network with Active Directory, AFAIK it can be queried with [mod://Net::LDAP]. You could try, for example, the code provided in this article: [http://perlmaven.com/reading-from-ldap-in-perl-using-net-ldap|Reading from LDAP in Perl using Net::LDAP].

Update: By the way, other modules like [mod://Email::Simple] and [mod://Email::Sender] provide a somewhat easier-to-use and more modern interface to sending mail than using [mod://Net::SMTP].

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
